style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.sk_floor_boils: Inn floorboards bulging by lamplight, centipedes pouring from a knothole in a dark bedroom
pictures.sk_floor_boils_2: A sleeper's shape seen from behind the bedpost as a swarm of centipedes rises over the blanket
pictures.sk_bitten: Villagers huddled in blankets in a lantern-lit village square at twilight, bowls and buckets beside them, a faint green gleam on their faces
pictures.sk_bitten_2: A split flour sack on a bakery floor alive with centipedes, a baker's hands hovering over it
pictures.sk_tunnels: A hand-drawn map of a village with thin tunnel lines running north-west into wooded hills
pictures.sk_tunnels_2: Tiny tunnels in a cellar floor, dozens of centipedes streaming along them toward the north-west wall
pictures.sk_oakum_turn: A woman in a butcher's apron ahead of the party in moonlit hills, her nose lifted to a deer in the trees
pictures.sk_oakum_turn_2: A silhouette bent and lengthening into a wolf among moonlit trunks, then a wolf crouched in bracken with its eyes lowered
pictures.sk_glitterdeep: A mining headframe and winch tower over a black square pit, a chain hanging into the dark, green gas rising against wooded hills
pictures.sk_glitterdeep_2: A warehouse sign reading Glitterdeep with two letters painted over so that it says Skitterdeep
pictures.sk_lift_falls: The winch drum spinning free and a chain whipping through the air at the top of a mine shaft
pictures.sk_lift_falls_2: A wooden lift platform dropping down a square shaft, giant centipedes leaping from it to the walls
pictures.sk_stonoga_end: A tall stringy hag whose black eyes burst, her long neck curling like a dead centipede
pictures.sk_stonoga_end_2: A hag's body sinking into a spreading grey sludge on a laboratory floor, a small dead centipede curled beside it
pictures.sk_plague_lifts: A tide of centipedes streaming out under doors and across moonlit fields away from a village at twilight
pictures.sk_plague_lifts_2: A kind apothecary wiping a feverish brow as colour returns to the sleeper's face by lamplight
pictures.sk_reopening: A lord in a striped suit and a plump mayor in a bowler hat at a mine head with plans and labourers, a headframe behind them
pictures.sk_reopening_2: Labourers carrying new timbers toward a mine entrance in the morning, a freshly painted sign reading Glitterdeep
pictures.sk_cave_in: Miners feasting at a long table with a tall glamoured woman who ladles them soup, lamplight gold and warm
pictures.sk_cave_in_2: Tunnels coming down in dust and rubble while knights in wine-red surcoats ride in with torches
pictures.sk_kindred: A cage in a laboratory holding the belongings of a missing person, a ledger beside it open to a page of cold handwriting
pictures.sk_kindred_2: A wall in the deep mine etched with rows of centipedes, a crooked house drawn at the centre
pictures.sk_rejuvenation: A tree freed of the plague, and in its bark a vision of a forest choked with fungus and a rotting deer
pictures.sk_rejuvenation_2: A hill tree with healthy green leaves in morning light, a faint sickly fungal glow in the shadows beneath it
